title: John Paul Lona
description:
An unguarded moment from RETURN OF THE JEDI: the aftermath of the sail barge battle on Tatooine. Born and raised in upstate New York, John Paul Lona got his professional start illustrating in the gaming industry for West End Games' STAR WARS line. He has since done work for other gaming companies, including GDW, TSR, and Fasa. In his spare time, of which there is little, he tries to get his son Zack to say "Batman." This being his first trading card Lona would like to dedicate it to his father, a card collector. "Hi, Pop!" 

ART: Kelly Ann Lona
